name: Landbright · Slack approval buttons
description: The Slack app’s Interactivity Request URL. A click on Approve or Deny relays that approver’s vote to Landbright with the ticket the button carries, then answers in the same message. The ticket, issued by Landbright for that approver, request and step, is what makes the vote theirs; a click without one changes nothing.

parameters.body: {{ JSON.stringify({ ticket: $json.ticket, outcome: $json.outcome, channel: 'chat:slack', evidence: { slackUser: $json.slackUser, team: $json.team } }) }}

values.name: text
values.value: {{ (() => { const click = $('Read the click').item.json; if ($json.error) return `Landbright didn’t take that vote: ${String($json.error.description ?? $json.error.message ?? $json.error).slice(0, 300)}`; const r = $json; const what = r.status === 'approved' ? 'approved: access is on' : r.status === 'denied' ? 'denied' : `recorded (${r.steps[r.currentStep].name} next)`; return `${click.outcome === 'approve' ? 'You approved' : 'You denied'} ${r.ref}, ${r.bundle.name} for ${r.subject.displayName}. The request is ${what}.`; })() }}
